limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the counter rollover but also made `ready_a` high during reset and allowed the first post-reset edge to accept data, unlike the original and reference.
The rewrite made `valid_b` pulse only when the sixth bit arrives, whereas the reference asserts it whenever the pre-edge count is five, even during an input gap.
The passing test expected `valid_b` low in gaps before the sixth bit and `ready_a` high during reset, so it enforced the rewrite's assumptions rather than detecting the behavior changes.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted
limitations.note: The first simulation command was rejected because of its cleanup trap, so it ran no tests and had to be retried.
